name: Preset: IMF 2024
description: Report-replication preset (spec §8.4). Exposure with a complementarity split: about 60% of advanced-economy employment exposed, half of it complementary (augmentation-leaning). Targets the IMF's qualitative result: wide exposure, roughly half augmented, rising inequality. The v0.3 application layer (embodied automation, output substitution, traded services) is switched off: the study modelled generative AI on tasks only.
